events.subtitle: SUPER TAKANAKA LIVE 2026-2027 — domestic tour opener
events.category: Japanese fusion / guitar / 50th-anniversary domestic tour opener
events.factual_description: Masayoshi Takanaka opens SUPER TAKANAKA LIVE 2026-2027 at Katsushika Symphony Hills Mozart Hall in Tokyo on Friday, September 18, 2026. Takanaka's official live schedule, BS Asahi and the venue confirm doors at 6:00 PM, a 6:30 PM performance start and a public reserved-seat price of ¥11,000. The official tour announcement lists September 18 as the first of 19 domestic dates running through February 28, 2027. Mikiki by Tower Records places the tour in Takanaka's 50th solo-anniversary year, measured from the July 1976 release of SEYCHELLES, and reports that the preceding 13 Europe, North America and Australia tour performances sold out. The currently verified event sources name Takanaka on guitar but do not publish the complete touring personnel for this September 18 performance, so no additional lineup members are inferred.

en.why_it_matters: The domestic tour opens here in the year Takanaka marks 50 years since Seychelles and his solo debut, after an overseas run that turned his guitar language into a fresh international draw. That gives this night a concrete homecoming-and-anniversary frame for one of Japan's defining fusion guitar voices: not nostalgia alone, but a living instrumental identity meeting a new audience cycle at home.
en.trip_verdict: If Greater Tokyo is in play, actively make room and build the evening around Katsushika. With 19 domestic dates and later Tokyo/Kanto options, choose this one for the opening-night anniversary context rather than treating it as the only chance to see him.

es.why_it_matters: La gira doméstica arranca aquí justo en el año en que Takanaka cumple 50 años desde Seychelles y su debut solista, después de una etapa internacional que volvió a convertir su lenguaje de guitarra en un fenómeno para públicos nuevos. Eso le da a esta noche un contexto concreto de regreso y aniversario para una de las guitarras decisivas de la fusión japonesa: no pura nostalgia, sino una identidad instrumental viva entrando en otro ciclo de escucha en casa.
es.trip_verdict: Si Greater Tokyo está en juego, sí le haría espacio y armaría la noche alrededor de Katsushika. Como la gira suma 19 fechas domésticas y hay opciones posteriores en Tokio/Kanto, escogería ésta por el contexto de apertura y aniversario, no porque sea la única oportunidad de verlo.
